headline: Government backs MSME digitalisation drive
summary: Zambia's government reaffirmed its commitment to accelerating digital transformation and formalisation of micro, small and medium enterprises. Minister Lackson Sichone made the remarks at the 2026 Infratel MSME Digital Open Day.
why: Small and medium enterprises make up most businesses in many African economies, so their formalisation and digital adoption affect productivity, tax collection and access to finance.
